title: Product Map: trace-coverage grouping
description: User story under REQ-170. a reviewer about to sign a chain off a trace-coverage grouping that buckets each REQ by chain completeness (complete, missing stories, missing AC scope or owner, missing component owner, missing tests)
asA: a reviewer about to sign a chain off
iWant: a trace-coverage grouping that buckets each REQ by chain completeness (complete, missing stories, missing AC scope or owner, missing component owner, missing tests)
soThat: I can see which requirements are safe to sign off and which still need work

acceptanceCriteria.description: The trace-coverage grouping buckets each REQ into one of complete | missing-stories | missing-ac-scope | missing-component | missing-tests, computed from the tree-model maps (storiesByReqId, acIdsByUsId, usByTacId, tsByAcId / tcsByAcId / fbsByAcId). Each REQ row states in plain text exactly what is missing, and links to its own doc anchor so the reader can jump to it.
